newsitem.title: USA: Wolverine Partners urges new Frisch board.
newsitem.headline: Wolverine Partners urges new Frisch board.

text.p: Wolverine Partners, which owns a 6.5 percent stake in Frisch's Restaurant Inc, on Friday reiterated their proposal that a majority of the restaurant chain's board members not have any ties to Frisch management.

"Independent boards have become the bedrock of American corporate governance," Wolverine's Jerry Ruyan said in a statement. "Staffing the board at Frisch's with qualified independent board members will bring this company in line with the rest of the corporate world."
In a letter to Frisch shareholders, Ruyan and Wolverine's Barry Nussbaum urged them again to vote in favor of changing the company's board structure.
